name: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABHA)
description: Creates a digital health ecosystem: ABHA ID, Health ID, Personal Health Records (PHR), and interoperable health information exchange.
benefits: Single health ID to link records across providers; consent-based sharing; easier continuity of care.
application_steps: Authenticate with Aadhaar OTP or other ID.
Link PHR address and records from providers.
faqs: How do I create a Health ID?
documents: Aadhaar / Driving Licence / any govt ID for ABHA creation
